nodes.title: Read the subparser dispatch design
nodes.summary: Sections 1 of the tutorial: one parser, one function per verb. No files change. Done when you can name the file to edit to add a --done flag to `list`.

verification.prompt: Say which file you would edit to add a --done flag to `list`, and why.

nodes.title: Scaffold src/todo with the dispatch table
nodes.summary: Section 2: create the package and build_parser()/main(). Done when the CLI imports and exposes both subcommands.

nodes.title: Prove the scaffold runs
nodes.summary: Section 3: run the CLI once so a broken parser is caught before features stack on it.

nodes.title: Add JSON persistence (optional branch A)
nodes.summary: Section 4: load()/save() against $TODO_DB. Optional, and independent of branch B - both unlock from 3-smoke as siblings.

nodes.title: Add table output (optional branch B)
nodes.summary: Section 5: render(tasks) with an empty-list case. Sibling of 4-store; neither waits for the other.

nodes.title: Export TODO_DB in your own shell
nodes.summary: Section 6: an external step the workspace cannot observe. Only reachable after persistence exists, because it is what the variable is for.

verification.prompt: Confirm TODO_DB is exported in the shell running the tutorial and echoes back a path.

nodes.title: Converge: confirm the features coexist
nodes.summary: Section 7: the two optional branches must not have fought over the same file. Skipped branches count as deliberate only if they are marked skipped.
